messages:
Ava (AE): Quick thread MonetBank wants an EU-only POC, full subprocessor list, and BYOK option. Can we confirm technical constraints and a short cost delta to quote?
Marco (Solutions Eng): Feasible. Main clarifiers: control plane EU-only or only inference/egress? BYOK via customer KMS/HSM or Redwood-managed key?
Ava (AE): Customer prefers EU control plane if possible, BYOK preferred but flexible.
Jamal (Infra): Notes: tenant_pin -> pin inference workers to eu-west-1, local KV/cache, no cross-region autoscaling. Expect +15-30% capacity overhead. Need VPC peering or tenant connector, IP allowlist, and cert rotation.
Priya (SalesOps): For quoting I need hosted geo-pin vs Dedicated reserved numbers and any one-time onboarding for BYOK.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Quick guidance: hosted+pin = fastest for POC, add routing/egress surcharge ~+10-15% per-token and possible burst engineering limits. Dedicated reserved = higher monthly commit (+20-40%) but predictable unit cost and avoids most cross-region egress. BYOK/HSM = one-time integration fee (~$4k-$6k) + legal addendum signoff.
LegalBot: Action: attach subprocessors CSV, DPA link, SCCs, and SOC2. BYOK requires vendor compatibility check and signed addendum before key provisioning.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Customer-facing tradeoff blurb to send:

"For strict EU residency we recommend either a hosted tenant-pin POC or Dedicated reserved capacity. Tenant-pin keeps inference and egress within EU and is fastest to stand up for a POC but can raise per-token costs due to constrained pooling and routing. Dedicated capacity provides predictable latency and unit economics for regulated production workloads but requires a monthly commitment and longer lead time. BYOK/HSM can be supported as an add-on with additional onboarding and legal steps."

Ava (AE): Marco please also draft a short ops checklist we can share with their infra team.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Ops checklist:
- Confirm EU region (eu-west-1) for inference workers and egress
- Decide if control plane must stay in EU or can be global
- Provide IP ranges and VPC peering/VPN details
- Confirm BYOK approach and vendor (KMS/HSM) details
- Validate cert rotation + key access flows
- Run perf smoke tests: p95/p99 latency and token throughput
- Define rollback/fallback policy (note: disabling fallback raises outage risk)

Jamal (Infra): POC infra recs: +2 g4dn-equivalent GPUs and a preflight test for KV cache locality. If they want no control-plane fallback, prepare incident runbook.
Priya (SalesOps): Timeline suggestion: Day 0 docs + subprocessors; Day 3 infra handoff and allowlist; Day 7 tenant pin + BYOK test; Day 10 perf runs; Day 14 wrap and pricing decision. I'll draft hosted vs dedicated quote + BYOK line item today.
Ava (AE): Great, send draft to customer once ready. Thanks team :thumbsup:
